label: STIT choice cell guarantees an outcome at a moment
definition: At moment m, take agent g and a representative history k through m. Cstit g k p holds exactly when for every history j through m in the same setoid class as k under g’s choice partition at m, p holds at j. For a withholding cell, p says that g does not give x being in the world mapped from j.
note: One history of nonproduction does not establish control over a cell. Withholding requires nonproduction throughout the represented choice class.
